decisions.reason: The rye country bread is an everyday core item made with established recipes and production, so it meets aspirations at low cost and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The premium raisin stollen is the flagship and repeatedly wins gold medals, so its results clearly exceed aspirations and dropping it is very unlikely.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the established bread range, there is no reported shortfall, and the firm already streamlined the range in 2024, so keeping it is the default.
The ancient grain bread was promoted as the newest masterpiece and its results are still uncertain, and growing industry turnover gives enough slack to carry it longer.
